title: Hands down the best college notebook for engineering!
comment: The paper quality is truly top-tier. Even with 0.7mm fountain and gel pens, there is zero ghosting or bleeding to the back page. The dividers make keeping semester notes organized a breeze.

productName: Pentel EnerGel Retractable Liquid Gel Pen 0.5mm
title: Lifesaver for left-handed writers!
comment: I write fast and normally my palm gets covered in ink. EnerGel dries within half a second! Absolutely smooth line without scratching the paper.

title: Aesthetic pastel colors, no bleeding
comment: Much better than blinding neon highlighters. The soft lavender and mint shades make studying medical textbooks pleasing to the eye.

productName: Parker Vector Matte Black Fountain Pen
title: Classic executive feel with great ink flow
comment: Very sleek pen for office note-taking and signatures. Gives a sophisticated weight in hand.
